status: execution protocol fixed before this formal run; informed by prior pilots, not preregistered
output: component clipping to [0,1], then sRGB encoding when needed
background_selection: synthetic neutral and mildly tinted endpoint canvases, not a measured prevalence sample
baseline_conditions: Numerical difference/exclusion in matched linear-light space; browser-native encoded-sRGB modes checked separately. No superiority claim from different arithmetic spaces.
full_sources: all 256^3 encoded 8-bit sRGB values, every source retained including neutrals

stress.distribution: uniform regular encoded-sRGB grids, not Web prevalence

threshold_scope: contrast thresholds are diagnostic, not whole-page WCAG certification

timing.primary: below-one versus above-one in same renderer
timing.claim_scope: prototype path overhead, not unmodified browser-engine overhead

storage: aggregates, histograms, extrema and deterministic generators; not billions of raw rows
